cohort: Women who delivered at ≥28 weeks gestation between January 1, 2008 and December 31, 2012 at the University of Port Harcourt Teaching Hospital
finding: Older parturients (≥40 years) have a higher risk of medical disorders of pregnancy, are more likely to deliver by caesarean section, and have low birth weight babies than their younger counterparts (20-29 years).
